description:
A team of long-lived bots for DeepSeek Harness.

DeepSeek Bot (DS Bot) is a bot plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) that turns DSH into long-lived bots. You create your own bots, then talk and work with them, with bot-to-bot messages and group chats.

The desktop app brings its own DSH, so you do not need to install DSH first. Bots can run tools, keep their own memory and files, and answer side questions while they work.
- Privacy Bot: a Bot can be marked private; other Bots cannot read its folder, memory or chats, and sharing needs your approval.
- Bots can read, check and edit Word, PowerPoint and Excel documents.
- A Bot can propose a new skill or an AGENTS.md update after long work; applied only when you approve.
- Group details can stop all work in the group at once.
- The sidebar can be dragged to resize or folded to an avatar rail; narrow windows fold the Bot panel first.
- Bot views run on the shared Deep View package.
- Fixes: group-name tooltip on truncated names, read_group_chat on notice rows, installer writable-folder check.
- DS Bot tracks DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.4.
